units.source_text: 源氏出门之后，众侍女也都散去。

en.t: After Genji went out, all the ladies-in-waiting dispersed as well.

units.source_text: 小侍从便走到三公主床前，问道：“昨天那封信哪里去了？

en.t: The young attendant then went to the Third Princess's bedside and asked, "Where did yesterday's letter go?

units.source_text: 今天早上大人在看一封信，信笺的颜色很像那一封呢。”

en.t: This morning, His Lordship was reading a letter, and the color of its paper looked very much like that one."

units.source_text: 三公主知道闯祸了，眼泪淌个不住。

en.t: The Third Princess knew she had caused trouble, and tears kept streaming down her face.

units.source_text: 小侍从看了她那窘状，心里埋怨她太不中用，继续问道：“你到底把它放在哪里了？

en.t: Seeing how flustered she was, the young attendant inwardly blamed her for being so helpless and went on asking, "Where on earth did you put it?

units.source_text: 那时有人走进来，我想：人家看见我挨在你身旁谈什么事情，会起疑心。

en.t: At that time someone came in, and I thought: if people saw me close beside you talking about something, they would become suspicious.

units.source_text: 即使是小小一点疑窦，我也提心吊胆，所以我就避去了。

en.t: Even the slightest suspicion frightened me, so I withdrew.

units.source_text: 后来过了一会，大人才走进来。

en.t: A little while after that, His Lordship finally came in.

units.source_text: 我总以为在这期间你已经把信藏过了。”

en.t: I had assumed all along that you had already hidden the letter during that interval."

units.source_text: 三公主说：“不是这样的，我正在看信时，他就走进来。

en.t: The Third Princess said, "That is not what happened. While I was looking at the letter, he came in.

units.source_text: 我来不及藏过，把它塞进坐垫底下，后来忘记了。”

en.t: I had no time to hide it properly, so I shoved it under the cushion and later forgot about it."

units.source_text: 小侍从听了这话，不知所云，连忙走到外室，揭起坐垫来一看，那封信已经不知去向。

en.t: Hearing this, the young attendant was dumbfounded and hurried to the outer room; when she lifted the cushion and looked, the letter had already vanished.

units.source_text: 她回进房来，对三公主说：“啊呀，大事不好了！

en.t: She came back into the room and said to the Third Princess, "Oh no, this is terrible!

units.source_text: 那位也非常忌惮我家大人，即使有一点儿风声走漏到大人耳中，他也觉得可怕，所以一向十分小心谨慎。

en.t: That gentleman, too, is deeply afraid of my lord; since he would be terrified if even the slightest rumor reached my lord's ears, he has always been extremely cautious.

units.source_text: 岂知事隔未久，就闯了这件大祸！

en.t: Who would have thought that before long such a disaster would happen!

units.source_text: 归根到底，是你自己疏忽大意，蹴鞠那一天被他从帘底窥见了，使得他多年不能忘怀，而埋怨我不给他牵线。

en.t: In the end it was your own carelessness: on the day of kemari he glimpsed you from beneath the blinds, and because of that he could not forget you for years and blamed me for not bringing you together.

units.source_text: 但我万万想不到你们会发生这等关系的。

en.t: But I never in my wildest dreams thought that the two of you would enter into this kind of relationship.

units.source_text: 这对你们两人都很不利呢。”

en.t: This is very bad for both of you."

units.source_text: 她剀切直言，毫无惧惮。

en.t: She spoke earnestly and bluntly, without the slightest fear or hesitation.

units.source_text: 大概是因为公主年幼，不须顾虑，向来习惯如此吧。

en.t: Perhaps because the princess was young and there was no need for reserve, she had long been accustomed to speaking this way.

units.source_text: 公主默默不答，只管哭泣。

en.t: The princess remained silent and gave no answer, doing nothing but weep.

units.source_text: 她非常忧虑，一点东西也不吃。

en.t: She was terribly distressed and would not eat a single thing.

units.source_text: 不知内情的众侍女相与言道：“大人眼看见我家公主病得如此，却专心一意地去照顾今已病愈的紫夫人。”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting who did not know the circumstances said to one another, "His Lordship sees our princess so ill, yet he devotes himself entirely to caring for Lady Murasaki, who has already recovered."
